skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK (+10) damage to a single target, with a 100% chance to inflict [Internal Injury] on the target (when the target is hit, adds Internal Injury damage equal to 100% of Gouketsu's ATK; the effect disappears after triggering).

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 60% ATK (+3) damage to all targets with a 3-hit combo, and simultaneously restores HP equal to 20% of own max HP.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 70% ATK (+3) damage to all targets with a 3-hit combo, and simultaneously restores HP equal to 30% of own max HP.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). Self gains 30% Non-CRIT DMG immunity (the reduction includes all damage types; this effect and [Agility] only one takes effect). At the start of battle, grants self and surrounding allies 70% Healing rate and Shield rate for 2 turns.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). Self gains 35% Non-CRIT DMG immunity (the reduction includes all damage types; this effect and [Agility] only one takes effect). At the start of battle, grants self and surrounding allies 80% Healing rate and Shield rate for 2 turns.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). Self gains 38% Non-CRIT DMG immunity (the reduction includes all damage types; this effect and [Agility] only one takes effect). At the start of battle, grants self and surrounding allies 90% Healing rate and Shield rate for 2 turns.

effects.desc: Damage over time based on ST, disappears after activation; Can Detonate to explode.
